basic_info.description: Presenting a rare opportunity to acquire an 8-unit residential income property, nestled in an excellent location within the Outer Richmond, offered for sale for the first time in almost 40 years. This  desirable property consists of 6,060 approx. building sq. ft. on a 4,996 approx. lot, featuring all 1 Bedroom / 1 Bath units, 100% occupied, 1:1 parking, and with tremendous upside potential. 4325 Balboa Street Apartments features a seismic upgrade completed in 2016, new roof in 2019 with new flashings / resealed in 2024, new fire alarm system in 2023, and new exterior paint in 2025. There are 8 of 8 fully residential units fully occupied, 1 unit was recently updated in 2022, leaving 7 units for upside potential. Transportation is a breeze with multiple bus lines and major thoroughfares in close proximity, allowing for easy commuting and access to all corners of the city. Additionally, the property is conveniently located near excellent schools, parks, and recreational facilities. Don't miss this gem of an opportunity to own this fully occupied 8 unit apartment with incredible potential for upside.
